name: How Your Client Sees It
description: Walks through Iker from the client's side: the booking link, choosing a service and an open time, the Refund Policy they accept, the deposit they pay outside the app with proof of payment, then what the owner sees and confirms. Includes a vertical cut.

scenes.title: The situation
scenes.guidance: How a booking happens without the link: a long chat, an account number sent by DM, a transfer screenshot to find later. Then promise to show the client's side of the link.

lines.text: What the client has to do today

scenes.title: The booking link
scenes.guidance: The public booking page the client opens from the link: no app, no account, the services with name, price and duration. Say the footage uses made-up data.

scenes.title: Choosing a service and a time
scenes.guidance: The client adds a service, picks a day and one of the open times, and enters their details. Only shipped steps, named as the page names them.

scenes.title: The Refund Policy
scenes.guidance: The client reads and accepts the business's Refund Policy before the payment step, and the booking keeps a copy. Policies depend on the plan: say so.

visual.headline: The policy comes before the payment

scenes.title: Paying and uploading proof
scenes.guidance: The deposit and the business's bank details, the transfer made outside the app to the business's own account, and the proof of payment upload. Iker records the payment; it never takes or holds the money.

scenes.title: Chapter card
scenes.guidance: Leave empty: this is a silent chapter card that switches to the owner's side.

scenes.title: What the owner sees
scenes.guidance: The booking under Awaiting confirmation, the proof on the booking, the owner checking their own account, then Confirm booking or Reject payment.

scenes.title: What changes
scenes.guidance: Answer the hook: what the owner now has, on the booking. No promised outcomes, no numbers the research does not support.

scenes.title: Next step
scenes.guidance: One next step, using the site's own call to action.

scenes.title: Outro
scenes.guidance: Leave empty: brand outro without narration.

scenes.title: Hook
scenes.guidance: The chat-and-screenshot problem in one or two sentences.

scenes.title: The client's side
scenes.guidance: The client books from the link and reaches the payment step. Say it is made-up data.

scenes.title: The owner's side
scenes.guidance: Awaiting confirmation, then Confirm booking once the owner has checked their account.
